plugins.name: jmwmllc
plugins.description: jmwmllc's Claude Code skills. feedback-mode — a dev-only, framework-agnostic in-browser feedback-capture widget that ships notes to a central mission-control dashboard. agent-queue — set up an autonomous agent work queue (in-app flag + bearer-token list/ack API + local puller + scheduled worker that builds, verifies, commits, and acks queued tasks, with safety rails and self-expiry).

plugins.name: dynamic-todos-sessions
plugins.description: Files each Claude Code session as a task in Dynamic Todos, under an agent named for the computer, renames it when the work changes, and sets off its follow-up alarm whenever Claude needs you. Set up from Dynamic Todos: ⚙ menu, Connect a computer to Claude Code.
